Type: sofa
Name: Strathwood Rhodes Deep Seat Loveseat
Colors: Black
Materials: Aluminum
Deep-seat loveseat for outdoor use; all-weather cushions with fabric ties to secure to frame Durable extruded-aluminum frame with black powder-coat finish; 100-percent polyester cushion covers Some assembly required; imported; coordinates with other pieces from the Rhodes collection (sold separately) Spot clean cushions; cover/store during inclement weather; weight capacity of 500 pounds Measures 31.9 inches long by 52.2 inches deep by 32.1 inches high
